_about: The Video Studio's character bible (Levi, 4 Nov 2026: 'The characters have to be the same always from scene to scene and episode to episode'). The words are the Episode Engine's (studio/EPISODE-ENGINE.md), word for word. Every generated picture is made FROM these refs. Add a picture to studio/refs/<id>.png (or .jpg) and it is used from the next video on. Voice ids: paste an ElevenLabs voice id once and every episode uses it.
style_lock: Modern premium children's animated series still, warm hand-painted storybook animation look exactly matching the attached reference pictures (not photo-real, no 3D render look), warm cinematic lighting, gentle rounded shapes, expressive faces with big readable emotions, rich but soft colors, Midnight Navy #1B2D5F shadows, Scripture Gold #F5C518 magical light, Traveler Teal #5BD3DC sparkles, 16:9 frame, no new text, no captions, no watermarks. Keep all four Travelers exactly as in the attached reference sheet and portraits: same faces, hair, skin, eyes, proportions, outfit for this scene, and trait colors. In the playroom, match the attached playroom picture exactly.
scripture_world: historically grounded ancient setting, natural earth tones, the Travelers have a faint glowing outline in their trait colors.
rules: Say 'Heavenly Father', never bare 'God', in dialogue and story narration.
The Travelers never interact with scripture characters; they watch from nearby, glowing faintly in their trait colours.
Heavenly Father is never shown as a figure: light and/or a voice speaking only scripture words.
No new text in any picture or video; titles and captions are added by the studio.
Never use the names Rockwell, Shamrock, Maylyn or Amay.
friends: THE FOUR ARE FRIENDS (not siblings or cousins). Each has their own family. Parents have no names: they are just "Mom" and "Dad" (for example "Beau's Mom").

chant.launch: Brave hearts, bright sparks, kind hands, wise eyes — to the world's most treasured true stories we fly!
chant.return: Treasure in our hearts, light to lead the way — home we fly to live it every day!

characters.name: Beau
characters.trait: BEAU — "Bo the Brave." Color: warm brown. Trait: courage and faith. Catchphrase: "Big heart, brave start!" Acts first, steps up, sometimes too fast; protective; grows by learning courage comes from trusting Heavenly Father, not from being loud.
characters.look: BEAU (boy): slightly sturdy toddler build; warm light tan skin; rounded face, full cheeks, light freckles; large dark brown eyes; thick dark brown eyebrows; dark brown thick curly hair, short faded sides, fuller curls on top; brave, warm, confident smile. Weakness: acts before he asks.
characters.all_four: ALL FOUR: toddlers, age 4, head = 1/3 of body height, always appear together, same face structure, hair, skin, eyes and proportions every time. Heights: Beau 100%, Scout 102%, Willow 98%, Wren 97% of Beau. (Ignore any "of Rockwell" text printed on the reference sheets; it means "of Beau.")

Weakness: carries feelings that aren't hers to carry.

characters.name: Grandma Lewis
characters.look: GRANDMA LEWIS — 74, 5'8", slim and active, fair skin with warm rosy undertones and freckles, long oval face, green-hazel eyes, long chestnut-brown hair with auburn undertones, center part, usually a low ponytail, gold hoop earrings, warm comforting smile. Outfits from her sheet only (cream cardigan with sage joggers and pink slippers; pink floral pajamas; lavender hoodie; green gingham shirt; navy track set; blue cardigan with floral skirt). Loving, wise, a family storyteller; loves scripture stories, temple visits, homemade treats, gardening and hymns. For Christian-audience episodes she reads "the scriptures" (show a Bible); for Latter-day Saint episodes she may hold the Book of Mormon.

places.name: The playroom
places.look: SET LOCK — THE PLAYROOM (must look identical every episode; match the uploaded playroom picture): a cozy attic room with a slanted white wood-plank ceiling and wooden beams; a big slanted skylight window on the left looking out at pine trees and blue sky; warm string lights and copper pendant lamps; a full wall of wooden bookshelves with colorful books and small scripture-verse plaques, colorful pillows along the top, a globe and a plant; a rolling library ladder on the right; a framed painting of Jesus Christ in a white robe with radiant light on the right wall; a "Build · Create · Imagine" pegboard and wooden workbench with building blocks; a whiteboard easel; a white play-kitchen sink on the left; a small wooden kids' table with chairs and colored pencils; two round red braided rugs; four wooden rocking chairs in a row (Beau, Scout, Willow, Wren, left to right); the two real pets, MARGO the dog (brown-and-white curly-coated doodle, long floppy ears, happy pink tongue) and SPARKLES the bunny (fluffy white bunny with black ears and black eye patches), usually lying on the two round rugs (they replace the plush toys seen in the empty-playroom picture); a teddy bear in a basket on the right. CENTER: THE TRAVEL CHEST — an old wooden chest with iron bands and rivets and a front plaque reading "The Travel Chest — World's Most Treasured True Stories." Never move, add or remove furniture. Never add new words to the room; only the signs already in the reference may appear.
